name: Lamp flicker
visual_intent: Warm oil-lamp glow and vignette breathe with seeded noise stepped a few times a second: the storyteller's lamp keeps every held frame alive.
implementation_summary: Warm oil-lamp glow and vignette breathe with seeded noise stepped a few times a second: the storyteller's lamp keeps every held frame alive.
